{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Remove rows where biomarker_baseline == -999 (QC failure)
df_clean = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]
print(f"Number of rows after removing biomarker_baseline == -999: {len(df_clean)}")

# Step 2: Deduplicate by keeping the row with the highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df_clean.loc[df_clean.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]
print(f"Number of unique patients after deduplication: {len(df_dedup)}")

# Step 3: Compute the mean of biomarker_baseline (already in ng/mL)
mean_baseline = df_dedup['biomarker_baseline'].mean()
print(f"Mean baseline biomarker value (ng/mL): {mean_baseline}")"}
